capture.note: tool_decision is the only signal that reports a reject: an allow came from config (source:config), both denials came from PreToolUse hooks (source:hook). tool_source distinguishes builtin from mcp. The gated tool_parameters attribute (full command / MCP server+tool names) is present on the wire under OTEL_LOG_TOOL_DETAILS=1 and is dropped at ingest (see the -otlp fixture); it is not reproduced here.

observations.name: approvals
observations.evidence: tool_decision carries decision/source/tool_name/tool_source/tool_use_id and maps to a canonical.Event approval signal (approved/denied). Reject decisions appear only on this event; tool_result.decision_type is always accept.
